flows.summary: Maintainer scans the repo being mapped and gets the list of every entry point, the join key for all later passes.

steps.name: Maintainer lists every entry point of the target repo into inventory.json
steps.notes: Adapter chosen per [[entry]] in flowmap.toml (cli, fastapi, nextjs, rails); only the cli adapter is exercised in this repo.

flows.summary: Maintainer prepares independent mapping passes for agents and checks each pass's citations and coverage.

steps.name: Maintainer generates the brief an agent follows for one mapping pass
steps.notes: Fills flowmap/RUN_SPEC.md with method text and stack text; reads flowmap.toml.

steps.name: Agent maps the codebase and writes its run JSON following the brief
steps.notes: No code: the agent is the actor. Included because verify and reconcile consume its output.

steps.name: Maintainer verifies a pass's anchors exist and every entry point is placed
steps.notes: Prints BAD/MISS lines to stdout and exits 1; writes nothing.

flows.summary: Maintainer merges independent passes into one consensus map and gets a list of disagreements to decide.

steps.name: Maintainer reconciles passes into map.json, MAP.md and QUESTIONS.md by agreement
steps.notes: Reads inventory.json, runs, and optional decisions.json (human-owned). Test hits come from [code].tests.

flows.summary: Maintainer renders the consensus map as Mermaid diagrams and an interactive atlas page.

steps.name: Maintainer generates Mermaid diagrams at system, flow and step zoom
Maintainer builds the interactive atlas HTML, optionally overlaying PR changes
steps.notes: Renders atlas.template.html with embedded JSON. Imports lens and diagrams as libraries.

flows.summary: Reviewer sees where a PR lands on the flow map and which entry points a code symbol can affect.

steps.name: Reviewer places a git change on the map: touched steps, reach and off-map code
steps.notes: Reads map.json and git history; prints markdown to stdout.

steps.name: Developer asks which entry points and flows can reach a given symbol
steps.notes: Subcommand 'impact' prints reach; no args prints graph size. bin/flowmap documents it but the dispatcher lists it.

observations: flowmap/atlas.py:overlay re-implements PR change detection (changed_lines/symbols_at/endpoint_set from lens.py) with its own changed/new classification, parallel to flowmap/lens.py:main.

flowmap/atlas.py:build and flowmap/callgraph.py:__main__ import other command scripts as libraries (diagrams, lens), so 'commands' are also shared modules; flowmap/atlas.py:step_code duplicates flowmap/diagrams.py:Diagrams.step.
flowmap/callgraph.py:endpoint_flows and flowmap/diagrams.py:Diagrams.__init__ each independently load inventory.json and map.json to build the endpoint-to-handler lookup.
flowmap/verify.py:anchor_ok uses regex definition matching while flowmap/callgraph.py:Graph uses the AST, so what counts as a valid symbol can differ between verify and the call graph.
flowmap/reconcile.py:main is one very large function doing voting, step clustering, evidence and file writing in one body.
flowmap/inventory.py:endpoints is reused by lens.py via git revisions through a custom read callable; the 'inventory' command itself only writes the worktree view.
